items.t: Windshield may not be bonded securely (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check the VIN to see whether it was done.

items.t: Front lower ball joint can separate
items.job: Replace front lower ball joint (one side)
items.note: Price is for one side. An alignment is usually needed afterward.

items.t: Front strut or control arm comes loose
items.job: Replace front control arm or strut, then align
items.note: Struts are replaced in pairs. Rusted bolts or a damaged subframe add cost.

items.t: Soft brake pedal or weak braking
items.job: Replace brake master cylinder and bleed brakes
items.note: Price assumes the master cylinder is the cause. A leaking line or caliper costs differently.

items.t: Engine stalls or loses power while driving
items.job: Replace fuel pump (if testing points to it)
items.note: Get it diagnosed first. Sensor or ignition faults can cost much less.

items.t: Sudden loss of all electrical power
items.job: Clean or replace main fuse and battery cables
items.note: Often just a loose main fuse or cable end.

items.t: Oil leak from front crankshaft seal
items.note: Cheap on the 1.8L. On the 1.6L the timing belt has to come off, so it costs far more; replace the belt at the same time.

items.t: Steering wanders from worn inner tie rod
items.note: Add the cost of an alignment.

items.t: Check engine light comes and goes
items.note: Repair cost depends on what the codes show.

items.job: Replace spark plugs (and wires if worn)
items.note: Injector or coil faults cost more.

items.t: Rotten egg smell from the exhaust
items.note: Fix any rich-running engine problem first, or the new converter can fail too.

items.t: Hard to start, then dies when warm
items.note: The repair depends on what testing finds.

items.job: Replace front brake pads and resurface or replace rotors
Replace clutch disc, pressure plate and release bearing
items.note: Flywheel resurfacing or replacement adds cost.
Ask a Suzuki-trained shop about bulletin SC18; the valve itself adds parts cost.

items.t: Crankshaft pulley or timing belt failure
items.job: Replace timing belt and tensioner (check crank pulley and bolt)
items.note: No parts-plus-labor source found, so this is based on RepairPal: $541–$824 for the twin Suzuki X-90 timing belt (same 1.6L engine family), plus $352–$551 for the Esteem tensioner alone. One 1998 Esteem owner was quoted about $500 at a chain shop. A broken crank pulley or engine damage adds cost.
Based on YourMechanic: $157–$194 for an Esteem horn relay (about $31 in parts). Check the fuse first; a bad horn or steering wheel contact costs differently.
